column1: # Sixty-one more notices and filings on purchases of AI servers and cards, 2024 to November 2026, found by later searches and read in their saved copies on Nov 25, 2026. Kept apart from tables/procurement_records.tsv, whose fourteen columns come first here: 50 of the 61 notices are not in that table, 7 are further sources for three purchases it holds (it cites them since Nov 25, 2026), and 4 are not new to it: 3 it cites, and 1 is a second outlet's page for a purchase it holds (column new_to_project_table says which). Six more columns: the item line as the page prints it; how Nvidia is named (by brand, by model, by architecture only, or not at all); what the page's field on imports says; whether the notice refuses or requires Nvidia hardware by name (six notices of Nov 2025 to Nov 2026 require it; three more, of May, Sept and Oct 2026, ask for the H20 by name: two universities' intentions, one of them to rent servers, and a leasing company's tender; none refuses it); whether the row is new to the project's table; and the row's place in the search list it came from. A tender is not a purchase; an award or a list of candidates is a contract decision, not a delivery and not an import. Not a census: a sample widened by search, and some notices the search reported could not be saved and are not rows. One page stands in tables/purchase_notices_2024_2025.tsv too (the Fudan University award, cn-ga31-h20notices-4); nothing is merged.
